items.description:
Bolton Shoes trades from its own store on Malherbe Street in Elsies River, selling footwear under the tagline 'crafted in South Africa since 1859.' The range runs across men's, women's, kids' and school shoes, with a dedicated corporate department and an accessories section, stocking brands such as Grasshoppers and Bronx in everyday styles from leather moccasins and lace-ups to casual sandals, heels and platforms. Online orders over R1,499 qualify for free delivery, and shoppers can also pay in three instalments through PayJustNow at checkout, with a leather-care guide on hand for customers who want to look after their shoes once they're home.

The store is based in Elsies River, Cape Town, and suits families, school-shoe shoppers and workplaces needing corporate footwear, with everyday and dress styles covered under one roof.

items.description:
Cape Town Appliances sells scratch and dent appliances from leading brands at its outlet store in Montague Gardens. Stock includes fridges and freezers, ovens, stoves, microwaves, hobs, laundry appliances and dishwashers, and the business also offers on-site and off-site repairs to all appliances.

Discounts range from 15% to 40% below normal retail pricing, and each appliance carries a one-year guarantee. Because stock depends on what suppliers deliver, items are sold first come, first served and must be viewed in store, so customers are advised to call ahead to check availability. An optional paid delivery service is available through an independent contractor.

The business says it has been helping customers find the right appliance for their homes for more than 30 years. It suits households and buyers who want leading brands at lower prices in Montague Gardens, Cape Town.

items.description:
Colour and Copy in Rondebosch is a full-service printing and copy shop. It offers colour and black-and-white printing, photocopying, faxing and scanning, along with posters, banners, plans, stickers, flyers, business cards, books and booklets, and printed T-shirts.

Finishing services include binding in plastic, wire spiral or hard cover, stapling, punching, laminating and guillotining. The shop also sells toner and cartridges, refurbished laptops, printers, UPS units and computer accessories, and it offers laptop and smartphone repairs and point-of-sale solutions. Bulk and student discounts are available.

The shop is at 26 Main Road in Rondebosch, with parking behind the Rondebosch Village Mall. It suits students, businesses and households who need quick copies or larger printing jobs in the area.

Compass House is a boutique hotel on the Atlantic Seaboard in Bantry Bay, with 16 rooms and units for up to 32 guests and a pool. The listing says every room has views of the ocean, and the interiors blend Mediterranean and Asian design influences.

The hotel is about two minutes from the beachfront and ten minutes from the city centre, so guests can combine a quiet seaside stay with easy access to Cape Town. Rooms can be booked online through the SA-Venues site, with credit card, instant EFT and bank transfer payment options.

It suits couples and travellers who want a stylish, small hotel close to both the sea and the city.

items.description:
Four and Twenty Cafe and Pantry is a French-inspired cafe and deli in Wynberg, in Cape Town's Southern Suburbs. It serves classic breakfasts, tasty lunches and inventive pastries, and it also sells take-home deli items.

The idea for the cafe came during a trip to Paris, and the founders kept the French theme in the setting. Café chairs fill an open-plan space, black-and-white silent films play on one wall, and the scent of homemade cakes fills the air. The atmosphere is chic and Parisian, with a soft palette and splashes of hot pink.

It is a good stop for a relaxed breakfast or lunch in Wynberg, or for taking home something from the pantry.

items.description:
Hair Freedom is a hair salon inside Kenilworth Centre, offering a full range of services for women, men and children at accessible prices. Precision haircuts, blow-dries and roller sets sit alongside colour work such as full colour, highlights, balayage, toning, colour correction and grey coverage using Redken, Kerastase and Goldwell products, plus chemical treatments including Mycro Keratin, Brasil Cacau and QIQI keratin smoothing, Japanese Silk straightening, relaxers and perms, each preceded by a consultation.

The salon serves clients from Kenilworth, Claremont, Harfield Village, Wynberg, Lansdowne and the surrounding suburbs, with walk-ins welcome for cuts and blow-dries while colour and chemical treatments are best booked ahead. Trading from Shop 43 in Kenilworth Centre on Doncaster Road, it suits families looking for one salon that can handle everything from a quick trim to specialist colour and smoothing work.

Harbour House is a seafood restaurant at Quay Four on the V&A Waterfront, known for its sweeping harbour views and white-tablecloth service. Regulars and reviewers point to the upper patio as the place for long, leisurely lunches, pairing fresh catch and local wine with dishes such as perfectly grilled fish, butter-drenched prawns and a well-regarded Caesar salad, while the calamari also holds up on quality.

The restaurant draws both loyal regulars and visitors marking a special occasion, with service that can slow down when the room is busy, particularly over holiday periods. Its position on the harbour makes it an easy stop for a long lunch or a celebratory dinner with water views on the Waterfront.

Hard Rock Cafe Cape Town in Camps Bay is part of the Hard Rock brand, which has been running for 47 years and is known for big portions and rock-and-roll memorabilia. The Camps Bay restaurant serves American-style food, including the signature Legendary burger.

The starters include chicken tenders, wings, bruschetta and nachos, and the combo plate brings together a little of everything, including wings, onion rings, chicken tenders and a spinach and artichoke dip. Reviewers say the restaurant is bigger than it looks from the entrance, with booths that suit families and activities to keep children busy.

The restaurant has outdoor seating and an upstairs level with views over the beach, and it suits families and groups who want a lively meal close to the water in Camps Bay.

Instruments South Africa (Pty) Ltd is an instrument supplier based in Paardeneiland, with an office overlooking the Port of Cape Town. Established in 2004, the company offers instrument testing and calibration, rental equipment, technical assistance and friendly counter sales.

The company describes its technologies as addressing energy efficiency and oil-in-water monitoring, with a focus on reducing downtime and boosting customer productivity. It holds a range of agencies and distribution agreements, and it offers diagnostic testing and calibration both at its office and on site.

It suits businesses that need dependable instruments, rental equipment and calibration support in the Cape Town port area.

Iron Horse Relocations is a storage and furniture removal company in Cape Town, handling house moves and office furniture removals. Its teams look after the packing, loading and delivery stages, and the business says its work is built on personal involvement with each customer at every level of the removal process.

Reviews on the homify professionals listing describe the crew as efficient, pleasant and careful, with one customer saying the move was a pleasant experience. The company focuses on quality, service and customer satisfaction, and it follows set procedures during packing, loading and delivery.

The business is based in Pelican Park, Montague Gardens, and serves Cape Town and the wider Western Cape. It suits homeowners and offices that need a careful, organised move.

items.description:
Kensington Place is a boutique hotel on the slopes of Table Mountain in Higgovale, with eight rooms and a setting the hotel describes as quiet opulence. Mr and Mrs Smith's listing describes it as a designer city den with a plunge pool and in-room pamper sessions.

Rates include breakfast, all-day dining is available, and the hotel has off-street parking. Check-in is at 2pm and check-out at 11am, both flexible on request depending on availability. The Kloof Street position puts guests within walking distance of the city's dining and shops, yet the hotel is removed enough for rest and romance.

It suits urbanites who want a city break with a quiet, design-led base close to Cape Town's beaches and attractions.

Kloof Street House is a restaurant set back from Kloof Street in Gardens, in a striking Victorian building with a treed courtyard. Inside, Gatsby-style furnishings, deep-buttoned leather sofas, dark-wood floors and a fireplace library create a candlelit setting.

The sheltered courtyard, lit with fairy lights and heaters, is used for winter brunches, lunches and dinners. Dishes have included pan-fried calamari, whole-baked camembert, Moroccan-spiced lamb rump, a beef burger and dark chocolate fondant, and the menu also features classy cocktails.

It suits diners who want an atmospheric meal in Cape Town's inner city, a short walk from the bustle of Kloof Street.

items.description:
Mama Africa is a restaurant and live-entertainment venue on Long Street in the Cape Town CBD, open every day from midday until midnight, with its kitchen serving until 11pm. Live entertainment runs nightly from 7pm, giving diners a show to go with their meal in the city centre.

The venue takes bookings for large groups and regularly fields questions from guests about reservations, dietary needs and parking, reflecting the mix of locals, tourists and groups it serves over a long evening. Parking is available on metered bays along Long Street or in secure garages on Bree and Buitengracht Streets, with car guards on duty once the sun goes down, making it a straightforward stop for dinner and music together.

Melkbos Hardware has been trading in Melkbosstrand since 1978 and is run by owners who live in Melkbos. The shop describes its approach as personal service, with a wide range of products at competitive prices, and says that if it does not stock an item, it will source it.

The shop stocks bicycle spares, building materials, lighting and electrical items, garden supplies, gas, general hardware, irrigation, paint, plumbing, pool supplies, sealers and varnish, security and keys, and water-saving products. It also works with local contractors and suppliers and says it is a supplier of well-known brands.

The store suits homeowners, gardeners and local contractors who want a neighbourhood hardware store with a wide range of stock.

Melkbos Kitchen is a relaxed eatery on the Melkbosstrand beachfront that opened in August 2017. It serves breakfast, lunch and dinner, and its menu changes often, using fresh, locally sourced and seasonal ingredients.

The restaurant is known for its views, with sea vistas and front-row seats to the Cape's sunsets from the beachfront. The team says its chefs take care to prepare and present each dish well, and it describes the setting as a chilled seaside village atmosphere with friendly service.

It is at 47 5th Avenue in Melkbosstrand, and suits anyone looking for a seaside meal with a view, from a morning breakfast to a sunset dinner.
